freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 注册即享免费额度（首次免费请求开启个人滚动 7×24 小时周期，非自然周/自然月重置）；免费路由默认关闭，需在控制台手动 opt-in（同意数据共享条款）。当前免费模型为 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、MiMo V2.6 Flash 与 TH-Rudder，名单为促销性质会轮换，以官网为准。提供 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 兼容接口。
freeTierSummary.en: Free allowance on signup (your first free request starts a personal rolling 7x24-hour period, not a calendar reset); free routes are off by default and require a dashboard opt-in (data-sharing terms). Current free models: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiMo V2.6 Flash, TH-Rudder; the promo lineup rotates, see the official site. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible.
